== Published English Original Virtual Set 5 wording ==
The original slip and the [[:File:SE-D-alertmystardestroyer-decipher-archive.gif|Decipher base card]] have no title dot. The remastered slip prints a dot. The period rule retains the restriction of the underlying card, and the source documents the printed mark. The simultaneous-deployment rule requires the pilot to deploy aboard its matching ship.
